bayts.text: The guidance of my God has removed what grieved me, removing it,
and has drained the well of my ignorance, a draining that removed my darknesses.
My heart has filled with knowledge, and my adversary has withdrawn apart;
and I have already turned away isolation, overcome by peace.
An Enricher Who pours out the lawful for me has driven error toward others than me,
and infirmity does not come toward me, nor the causes of pain.
The gift of the Everlasting, the Nourisher, leads to me the most profitable nourishment,
and I have become the delight of the times, through my work and my words.
Toward me the Lord of creation has led, giving into my possession the bracelet (cf. Qurʾān 43:53),
and for me has illumined my heart, freed from pain.
The sickness of the body does not come toward me, nor aversion, nor envy;
in him (the Prophet) my merchandise has not gone unsold, in sale or in advance sale (salam).
The Everlasting has led the price to me, and for me has made the time good,
with acts of nearness and with security, through His Chosen one, the ladder.
He has blessed and granted peace, without end, Who has accepted
my life, upon him who let down my (protecting) veil and raised my pen high.
My writing, effacer of sloth, gladdens the best of Messengers,
with its honey-sweet secret, bearing glad tidings, unwounded.
He who encompasses the comprehensive words (Muḥammad) has called my ink and the pens
to what removes darkness from the believer and the Muslim.
I have refined a writing that has in no way turned toward other than my Lord,
and truly I show the middle of the path of my Lord, the banner.
The enabling grace of my Lord has drained the well of idle talk, and it was drained,
and toward others than me has removed every misery and darkness.
